title: ballota acuta var. intermedia
intro: Ballota acuta var. intermedia, commonly known as Intermediate Ballota, is a variety of the Ballota acuta plant, a species of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, such as nausea and diarrhea, due to its health benefits of being an anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic agent. The therapeutic actions of Ballota acuta var. intermedia include its ability to reduce anxiety, promote relaxation, and alleviate menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of the plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
